pack_overview.summary: Aggregator: ComBank/Sampath/Seylan/HNB FD JSON → unified ladder. Content-verified 2026-09-15 (not just HTTP status): ComBank endpoint returns a real, full FD ladder with live rates (e.g. 24mo maturity 10.45-11.00%), not a false-healthy empty response. Checked as part of a wider sweep after finding the sibling sl-bank-card-offers-docs pack had a silent-empty-data bug on the same style of Sampath call — this one does not have that problem.
